theme_and_archetype.reasoning: Admin/Field Work application requires high utility, absolute clarity, and authority. The design must feel like a precision tool (control room for admins, tactile instrument for mobile field workers), using high-contrast utilitarian colors where color denotes function only.

rules: Labels and overlines must be Uppercase, text-xs, with wide tracking (tracking-[0.2em]).
Heading hierarchy strictly fluid, max text-6xl for largest viewports.
Data tables and timestamps MUST use IBM Plex Sans for tabular figure alignment.

admin_dashboard.widget_rules: Every pixel utilized. h-full on children for stretching.

mobile_pwa.padding: Generous spacing. p-6 or p-8 for main interactive containers.
mobile_pwa.bottom_nav: Fixed bottom nav with thick padding for mobile thumb reach.

surfaces_and_components.admin_cards: Grid Borders strategy. Flat backgrounds, 1px subtle borders (border-border), no shadows. Visible grid lines.
surfaces_and_components.mobile_interactive: Neumorphism / Tactile strategy for Check-in toggles. Sharp 1px border to ground it with soft shadows.
surfaces_and_components.header: Solid background with a hard 1px bottom border to separate from the map/dashboard content.
surfaces_and_components.map: High-contrast map pins and thick polylines (weight: 4px). Use primary and status colors.

motion.hover: Slight background tint shifts. Explicitly define hover text color (e.g., hover:bg-[#0047FF] hover:text-white).
motion.loading: Tactile, industrial loading bars (no bouncy generic spinners).

icons.weight: regular or bold for data legibility

login_background.description: Abstract topographic map background for the authentication/login screen.

brand_logo_placeholder.description: Abstract architecture logo substitute for Gyarahalli Thammayya Groups.

testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the Swiss & High-Contrast archetype. Never use soft pastel gradients.
Implement Shadcn UI for the dashboard and heavily customize tables/cards to remove default styling and apply the Grid Borders look.
For the Leaflet map, apply a monochromatic or light-themed tile layer (like CartoDB Positron) so the colorful route lines and pins pop out clearly.
Ensure the PWA UI is extremely thumb-friendly (large target areas, minimum 48px height for touch interactions).
Use data-testid for all check-in/out toggles, map markers, and admin filters.
